title: KKR to Pay Record Settlement in Premerger-Filings Case
title_zh: KKR 将在合并前备案案件中支付创纪录的和解金
summary: The amount KKR agreed to pay to settle a case with the Justice Department alleging that the private-equity giant withheld and altered documents in premerger filings. The previous record, a $12 million penalty, was collectively held by Edwards Lifesciences and Genesis MedTech.
summary_zh: KKR 同意支付的金额，以与司法部达成和解，指控这家私募股权巨头扣留并篡改了合并前备案文件中的文件。此前的记录是 1200 万美元的罚款，由 Edwards Lifesciences 和 Genesis MedTech 共同保持。

title: Your Annuity Might Be Backed by LeBron’s Nike Deal: Inside the $245 Million Two Retirement Insurers Are Betting on the King
title_zh: 你的年金可能会得到勒布朗与耐克的交易的支持：两家退休保险公司在 2.45 亿美元中押注于国王
summary: Your fixed annuity and LeBron James share a balance sheet, and the tax consequences of that arrangement fall entirely on you. Here is what the insurers funding his Nike deal are not telling their policyholders.
summary_zh: 您的固定年金和勒布朗·詹姆斯共享一个资产负债表，这种安排的税务后果完全由您承担。以下是为他的耐克交易提供资金的保险公司没有告诉保单持有人的信息。

title: XLF vs IYF: Which Financial Sector ETF Offers Better Value?
title_zh: XLF 与 IYF：哪个金融板块 ETF 提供更好的价值？
summary: XLF's ultra-low 0.08% expense ratio cuts costs dramatically, but IYF's 141 holdings deliver broader diversification and stronger 5-year returns.
summary_zh: XLF 0.08% 的超低费用率极大地降低了成本，但 IYF 持有的 141 只股票带来了更广泛的多元化和更强的 5 年回报。

title: Broadcom credit risk measures rise amid AI financing deals
title_zh: 人工智能融资交易导致博通信用风险指标上升
summary: Investing.com -- Bond traders increased credit risk measures for Broadcom Inc. as the company provides financial support for large AI-related financing packages.
summary_zh: Investing.com——债券交易员提高了博通公司的信用风险衡量标准，因为该公司为大型人工智能相关融资方案提供财务支持。

title: How NVIDIA’s AI Compute Financing Push and Blupine Deal Interest Could Impact Blackstone (BX) Investors
title_zh: NVIDIA 的 AI 计算融资推动和 Blupine 交易兴趣如何影响 Blackstone (BX) 投资者
summary: In August 2026, NVIDIA announced it had entered into partnerships with Blackstone, Apollo, BlackRock, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to create new compute financing platforms that could mobilize over US$500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure across its eco...
summary_zh: 2026 年 8 月，NVIDIA 宣布已与 Blackstone、Apollo、BlackRock、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 和 KKR 建立合作伙伴关系，创建新的计算融资平台，可以为整个生态系统的 AI 基础设施动员超过 5000 亿美元的第三方资本。
